setup: [a match from a dating app, or a direct message on social media, moves to [chat app name] and turns warm and affectionate over weeks of small daily messages: good mornings, photos, plans to meet one day] [the person always has a reason not to meet or video call: a broken camera, bad signal, work overseas]
ask: [out of love, not pressure, the person asks for money just this once: a gift they sent is held at customs and needs a fee, or an accident means a hospital deposit, or their account is frozen and they need help with a ticket to finally visit; or they offer to show the trading app that made them money] [each later ask is a little more than the last]
usualEnding: The transfers repeat, each with a new reason, and many of these chats turn into the investment pattern. The person in the photos never existed.
realTwin: A partner the player already knows in person video calls in the evening, and never asks for money.
